relationships.subject: suzetrigine
relationships.evidence_quote: Suzetrigine inhibited NaV1.8 channels in a dose-dependent manner following hyperpolarized pre-pulses

relationships.subject: suzetrigine
relationships.evidence_quote: Direct binding of suzetrigine to the VSD2 domain of NaV1.8 was confirmed using radiolabeled suzetrigine

relationships.subject: suzetrigine
relationships.evidence_quote: suzetrigine significantly inhibited APs in 10/17 DRG neurons recorded from three donor tissues at concentrations ≥ 1 nM

key_findings: Suzetrigine is a >=31,000-fold selective Nav1.8 inhibitor that binds VSD2 (KKGS motif) and stabilizes the closed state, producing tonic inhibition.
Suzetrigine inhibits action potentials in human DRG neurons; no CNS expression of SCN10A and no evidence of dependence or abuse potential.
